simple.meaning: אָסֻף (ʼâçuph) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “collected (only in the plural), i.e. a collection of offerings.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across 1 Chronicles, Nehemiah, beginning at 1 Chronicles 26:15. Its contexts include family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אָסֻף (H624).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
